about_the_game:
WishBreaker is a unique Class-based Genre Fusion Multiplayer ARPG. Class-based genre fusion, meaning different classes will experience the game with a twist of a different genre but players still blend together cohesively. Warriors experience the game as an ARPG Hack n' Slash Brawler, button mashing out combos, defeating enemies, collecting gear etc. Rogues however will experience the game slightly different as a Roguelike Stealth-based game. They will have unique moves such as Wall Press/ Corner Peeking, Prone Crawl, Crouch Walk, Cover-to-Cover Dash, Noise Management, Camoflauge, Distraction Tools, Silent Takedowns etc. The Rogue is the only class that plays as a Roguelike, meaning when they die, they lose all of their items they had on them. They can find their body to retrieve them, but there is a chance someone else may take their items. Fortunately the Rogue can also pickpocket to retrieve their stolen items! Hunters will rely more on a FPS HUD, etc. You can read about each classes unique playstyle in the different channels on the discord!

There are two types of Dungeons in WishBreaker, Surface Dungeons and Underground Dungeons. Surface Dungeons will have players grouping in a party to go and defeat enemies in a first or third person view (The Hunter is the only class specialized to play as a true FPS). The Underground Dungeons are Bullet Hell dungeons. Your skills and equipment adapt accordingly to a Bullet Hell style while in the Underground Dungeons. The surface in general has some Soulslike environments to you can immediately battle extremely difficult creatures if you'd like for Legendary loot! It won't be necessary to defeat these creatures if you choose not to. They are simply there for the players who enjoy Huge risk and Huge reward!

WishBreaker also features PVP! In normal areas you can invite players into a duel and wait for them to agree. Once they agree to a duel, you choose whether it's a casual duel or a Perma-Death duel. Perma-Death means your character is permanently dead and they player can no longer use that character. There will also be designated Arenas to engage in duels (1v1, 2v2, 1v2, etc) and each format provides different rewards. Unbalanced (1v2 etc.) Perma-Death will result in the highest rewards for the player with the disadvantage! There are also battlegrounds!!! (team vs team CTF etc.)

content_descriptors.notes: Fantasy Violence with some blood. No gore

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 or AMD Radeon R9 380
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1660 Ti / RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: A genre-fusion ARPG. Every class plays differently, Warrior plays as Hack n' Slash, Rogue as Stealth rougelike, Cleric is decision based, Druids play creature collecting/farming, Wizards are puzzles, secrets, and code casting and many more! PVE and PVP including Bullet Hell and Soulslike areas!
